decision_rationale: Celler is a new single-cell pretraining model, but the evidence only supports gene-expression tokens/cells as language-model analogies, not natural-language text or a text-bio bridge. The generative claim is not fully resolved because the method evidence is masked-value prediction rather than an explicit generative decoder or autoregressive setup.
